tasks.title: Central AuditService + additive actor_user_id migration
tasks.description: AuditService.record({companyId, actorType, actorUserId, action, entityType, entityId, from, to, reason?, humanText}) called in-transaction by quote/OS/payment/customer/company/invite/appointment services on every relevant mutation. Additive migration adds actor_user_id (nullable). metadata standardises {from,to,reason}. Human-readable contextual descriptions naming entity/context/customer (no 'Orcamento aprovou o orcamento'). This direct corrective successor reuses candidate 046969b76b5e4d5e046e8e9f62c724daf87a5aa0 and is restricted to the two actionable findings from attestation atn-6bbfb7faf8414322a76ae0a286d80e61; the INFO item is excluded and prior accepted corrections/tests must remain intact.
tasks.acceptance: AC1: AuditService.record persists a structured row inside the caller transaction; AC2: quote send/approve/reject/cancel/correct/reopen each write one audit row with from/to/reason; AC3: OS important status changes write audit; AC4: payment create/settle/change write audit; AC5: customer + company/profile important changes write audit; AC6: appointment create/edit/delete write audit where relevant; AC7: descriptions are human-readable and name the entity/context/customer; AC8: no exhaustive per-field enterprise audit added; AC9: reject and reopenOrCorrect validate and update the expected quote state atomically, preserve the expected status in the write predicate, and create exactly one audit row only for the winning transition, with positive, invalid, rollback, tenant, authorization, idempotency and concurrent-transition tests; AC10: reopening an expired quote transactionally assigns a future valid_until and a newly generated approval token/link, never retaining or reusing the expired approval capability, with security and rollback tests; AC11: the additive migration and all fixes/regressions already present in the rejected candidate are preserved without expanding corrective scope.

correctiveScope: atomic quote reject and reopenOrCorrect transitions with audit only for the winning conditional update
expired quote reopening renews valid_until and approval token/link transactionally

tasks.title: Surface action history (with justification) at actionable UI points
tasks.description: Two related UX gaps: (1) OS reopen already asks for a justification and records it via AuditService, but the justification does not render correctly in the front-end history; (2) more generally, actionable screens (OS, quote, payment, customer, appointment) need a lightweight way to see that item's own history. History display convention: a small button near the actionable item opens a compact history modal (or a small section at the bottom of the page, matching the pattern already used elsewhere) showing exact date/time, user, and action for each change. Fix OS reopen history first, then apply the same pattern to OS/quote/payment detail screens that already have an audit trail on the backend (AuditService) but no way to view it in the UI. A GLM review with a real REQUEST_CHANGES verdict (a genuine finding: the new UI calls a GET /audit-logs backend endpoint that does not exist yet, per ADR-015 §4) was discarded by a schema-validation bug (reviewerMeta.toolPolicy exceeded maxLength) that is now fixed on main; this version restarts on that fix so the correction loop can actually run. Scope fix: ADR-015 section 4 specifies GET /audit-logs as part of this feature (it does not exist yet), so apps/backend/src/audit and the apps/web/app/api/audit-logs proxy route are now in scope alongside the frontend paths - a prior version wrongly scoped this as frontend-only, causing the correction loop to revert the very backend read endpoint the review correctly flagged as missing.
tasks.acceptance: AC1: OS reopen justification renders correctly in that OS's history; AC2: OS detail, quote detail, and payment/finance panel each expose a small 'historico' button/section showing date/time, user, and action per audit row for that entity; AC3: no new audit-writing logic - this only surfaces existing AuditService data; AC4: no business decision auto-scheduled.

For any status change that requires a justification (e.g. reopening/correcting an OS or quote), clicking the action opens a small modal asking for the justification before applying it; the justification is recorded and shown in that item's history. Reuses PB1-P26's history surfacing for the new entries.

tasks.title: Tela Usuarios e permissoes (equipe) real no app mobile
tasks.description: O item Usuarios e permissoes no menu Mais do app mobile hoje e EmBreveScreen. O web tem gestao de equipe completa (apps/web/app/(app)/equipe/page.tsx). Owner quer paridade no app, ao menos leitura + convite. Correcao de escopo: o AC original pedia mudar papel/desativar membro, mas isso nao existe nem no backend nem no web ainda (so GET /company/members + convite). Reduzido para paridade real com o que o web ja tem. Contrato reiniciado apos troca de provider primario (claude) no config.v2.json de 2026-09-28 a noite.
tasks.acceptance: AC1: a tela lista os membros da equipe da empresa com papel (role); AC2: permite convidar um novo membro por e-mail, usando o mesmo endpoint do web; AC3: segue o design system mobile. Mudar papel/desativar membro fica fora desta task - o backend ainda nao expoe esse endpoint nem no web (comentario future: remove member em CompanyController).

tasks.title: Tela Documentos (PDFs de orcamento/OS) real no app mobile
tasks.description: O item Documentos no menu Mais do app mobile hoje e EmBreveScreen. O web ja baixa PDF de orcamento e OS (apps/web/app/(app)/documentos, PB1-P11/PB1-P12). Owner quer paridade no app - o tecnico em campo precisa poder baixar/compartilhar esses PDFs pelo celular. Contrato reiniciado apos troca de provider primario (codex) 2026-09-29.
tasks.acceptance: AC1: a tela lista os documentos (orcamentos e OS) com PDF disponivel; AC2: toque em um item baixa e/ou compartilha o PDF usando o endpoint ja existente no backend; AC3: mostra claramente o status (ex: pendente/emitido) igual a semantica ja definida em PB1-P12; AC4: segue o design system mobile.

tasks.title: Tela Plano e assinatura real no app mobile
tasks.description: O item Plano e assinatura no menu Mais do app mobile hoje e EmBreveScreen. O web ja mostra o plano atual e uso (apps/web/app/(app)/plano/page.tsx). Owner quer paridade no app. Linguagem de produto obrigatoria: uso justo, uso ampliado, Ver planos, Gerenciar assinatura - nunca pague fora do app nem falar em taxa da Apple/Google, dado que a Apple/Google exigem in-app purchase para conteudo digital em apps nativos.
tasks.acceptance: AC1: a tela mostra o plano atual (Orcivo Livre/Solo/Mais/Equipe) e o uso do mes (ex.: X/15 OS no Livre); AC2: botao Ver planos e Gerenciar assinatura presentes, linkando para o fluxo apropriado (web/checkout ou app store conforme a politica da loja - NAO implementar cobranca nova nesta task, e decisao de billing/Nivel C separada); AC3: nomenclatura de planos e linguagem seguem exatamente o CLAUDE.md do projeto (Orcivo Livre/Solo/Mais/Equipe; nunca FREE/POP/PRO/TOP).

tasks.title: Historico de acoes (audit) nas telas de OS e orcamento do app mobile
tasks.description: O web acabou de ganhar um historico de acoes legivel (data/hora, usuario, acao) nas telas de OS/orcamento/financeiro via GET /audit-logs (PB1-P26). O app mobile ja tem WorkOrderDetailScreen e QuoteDetailScreen mas sem historico. Owner quer a mesma paridade no app.
tasks.acceptance: AC1: a tela de detalhes da OS (WorkOrderDetailScreen) tem um botao/secao mostrando o historico de acoes daquela OS (data/hora exata, usuario, acao), consumindo o mesmo GET /audit-logs que o web (PB1-P26); AC2: a tela de detalhes do orcamento (QuoteDetailScreen) tem a mesma secao de historico; AC3: leitura apenas - nenhuma logica nova de escrita de auditoria; AC4: segue o design system mobile.

strategy.P-18: web MVP first; mobile controlled parallel catch-up; mobile parity does not block the web MVP
strategy.P-21: NFS-e / fiscal = FUTURE / POST-MVP / Level C; not scheduled
